name: Buy In
definition: Process in which the buyer/CCP repurchases shares of stock because the seller either failed to deliver the shares or did not deliver them in a timely fashion. The seller has to make up the price difference if the new shares are more expensive than originally agreed to.

BuyinDate.name: Buyin Date
BuyinDate.definition: Date at which the buy-in occurs.

Fees.name: Fees
Fees.definition: Fees related to a cash compensation or to a securities compensation in a buy-in process

SecuritiesCompensation.name: Securities Compensation
SecuritiesCompensation.definition: Securities bought in a buy-in process.

BuyInPrice.name: Buy In Price
BuyInPrice.definition: Provides the price of the buy-in.

CashCompensation.name: Cash Compensation
CashCompensation.definition: In case securities are not available to be bought-in by the buyer/CCP, a cash compensation is required from the seller. It is derived from the association ResultingObligation between ObligationFulfillment and Obligation.

RelatedSecuritiesClearingProcess.name: Related Securities Clearing Process
RelatedSecuritiesClearingProcess.definition: Clearing process which includes the buy-in.
